THE PUNJAB
MURDEROUS OUTRAGES (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 1877.
ACT No. IX OF 1877
[28th March,
1877]
An Act to revive and amend Act No. XXIII of 1867
WHEREAS Act No. XXIII of 1867
(for the suppression of Mur derous outrages in certain districts of the Punjab)
received the assent of the Governor General on the 18th day of March 1867, and
by section 17 of the said Act was limited to expire in ten years from the date
of passing it; And whereas it is expedient to revive the same Act and to amend
it in manner hereinafter appearing; It is hereby en acted as follows -----
1. The said Act shall be
revived and shall remain in force until the (Subs. by
A. O., 1964, Art: 2 and Sch, for ,"Central Government" which had been
subs. by A. O., 1937, for "G. G. in C.".)[Provincial
Government] otherwise directs. Act XXIII of 1867 to be revived.

Repealed
